vertice.resumo: A web platform for amateur VALORANT tournaments, which I'm building by orchestrating AI agents with Claude Code.

navegador.nota: Illustrated mock-up. The real site is at verticetour.com.br

comoFoiConstruido: I orchestrate role-specific AI agents in Claude Code: backend, frontend, testing, game rules and product.
The backend is covered by 49 automated test files.
I use GitHub Actions, deploy on Render and a PostgreSQL database on Neon.
AI agents monitor for failures; when an issue is flagged, I step in and fix it.
oQueFaz: Runs map vetoes for Bo1, Bo3 and Bo5 series.
Supports single-elimination, round-robin and group-stage formats.
Generates a public link to follow each tournament.
Bilingual and LGPD-compliant (Brazil's data protection law).
vertice.proximoPasso: Integration with the official Riot Games API.
vertice.origem: The tournaments I used to organize and play with friends: a real problem I was already solving by hand.

sobre.p1: I hold a bachelor's degree in Information Systems from Anhembi Morumbi University and an associate degree in Data Science from FIAP. My first hands-on work with real data was at Cushman & Wakefield, maintaining and cleaning databases with SQL for the systems team.
sobre.p2: At Salesforce, I built prototypes for ~7 sales opportunities, turning business requirements into technical demos. At KPMG, I tested IT controls on systems for 10+ global clients and translated business rules into testable verification criteria.
sobre.p3: Now my focus is Artificial Intelligence. I'm building Vértice with AI agents and taking FIAP's postgraduate program in AI for Developers. My technical skills are still at a basic level, except for Excel, and I learn by building.

bullets: Tested IT general and automated controls (access, change and operations ITGCs) on critical systems for 10+ global clients, working within each client's own tools and ERPs and flagging inconsistencies and operational risks.
Translated business rules into objective, testable verification criteria alongside cross-functional teams and clients.
Validated large data populations in Excel (VLOOKUP, SUMIF) to support control testing.
Standardized how assurance reports were finalized across teams, improving consistency and turnaround.
Built working prototypes on the Salesforce platform (flows, dashboards and permissions) for ~7 sales opportunities, turning complex business requirements into technical demos.
Supported technical validation on complex strategic accounts, helping the sales team close deals.
Trained internal teams across Latin America on in-house tools for creating demo videos.
Maintained and cleaned databases with SQL for the systems team, keeping information available for Tier 2/3 support.
Monitored the systems team's ticket queue, covering access requests, integrations and data fixes.
Created technical documentation and end-user training that reduced response time on technical tickets.

itens.resumo: Perishable inventory management with machine learning (Random Forest) and a Looker Studio dashboard.
